task: Making banana, kiwi, and strawberry skewers
query: How do I make banana, kiwi, and strawberry skewers?

goal.title: Make banana kiwi and strawberry skewers
goal.description: Rinse and prepare banana, kiwi and strawberries, cut the fruit into chunks and slices, and alternate the pieces on two long wooden skewers.
goal.final_state: Two loaded fruit skewers lie side by side on the amber plate at the end of the video.

procedure.description: Carry a banana and strawberries over the sink, operate the faucet and hold the fruit under running water. Put the strawberries on the amber plate and turn the faucet off.
Snap and pull the banana skin downward, briefly use the knife on the skin, then pull away the remaining peel. Put the peeled banana on the plate and move the peel aside while retrieving a kiwi.
Hold and rotate the kiwi while paring away long strips of brown skin with the knife. Repeatedly shave the remaining patches, then lower the peeled fruit to the plate.
Slice the kiwi into thick green rounds. Reposition the banana, crosscut it into chunks and rearrange pieces as cutting progresses.
Pick up the strawberries individually, cut off their leafy tops and move the caps aside. Halve the hulled berries and rearrange the prepared fruit on the plate.

Set the knife aside and retrieve a long wooden skewer. Alternately pierce banana chunks, strawberry halves and kiwi slices, sliding each down the stick. Finish loading the first skewer and place it to the right of the plate.
Retrieve another skewer and pierce a banana chunk, beginning the second fruit skewer. The supplied human fine divisions stop during this operation.
In the uncovered tail, slide the banana down the second stick, add kiwi, strawberry, more banana and further fruit pieces, and lay this second loaded skewer on the plate.
Retrieve the first skewer from the right, add a remaining banana piece, then lay both loaded fruit skewers side by side on the plate and adjust their arrangement.

coarse.instruction: Rinse the fruit and peel the banana
coarse.description: Rinse banana and strawberries, put berries on the plate, stop the water, peel the banana by hand with brief knife assistance, set it down and move the peel aside while retrieving kiwi.
coarse.goal_contribution: Cleans the fruit and exposes the banana flesh for cutting.

coarse.description: Rotate the kiwi while paring long skin strips and shaving remaining patches, then place the peeled fruit on the plate.
coarse.goal_contribution: Removes the kiwi skin before slicing it into skewer pieces.
coarse.predictability_reason: The kiwi still needs peeling before the fruit can be cut.

coarse.instruction: Cut the fruit into skewer pieces
coarse.description: Slice the kiwi and banana, reposition pieces, trim all three strawberry tops, halve the berries and rearrange the cut fruit.
coarse.goal_contribution: Produces the separate fruit pieces that will be threaded onto sticks.
coarse.predictability_reason: Washed and peeled fruit is ready to cut for skewers.

coarse.instruction: Assemble and set aside the first fruit skewer
coarse.description: Retrieve a skewer after setting down the knife, alternately thread banana, strawberry and kiwi pieces, finish loading it and place it on the right side.
coarse.goal_contribution: Combines prepared fruit into the first assembled serving.
coarse.predictability_reason: Prepared fruit pieces are ready to thread onto skewers.

coarse.description: Pick up a second wooden skewer and push a banana chunk onto it; coverage stops before the next fruit is added.
coarse.goal_contribution: Starts the second serving, whose continuation is visible in the uncovered tail.
coarse.predictability_reason: After the first skewer, making a second is a natural continuation.
